calls.thesis: BUY (first tracked) — guest Ross Given: Recursion's robots run millions of cell experiments and AI picks the drug; its AI-made cancer drug REC-1245 showed 87% of patients improving in a trial announced 2 Nov. Broke out of a $3-$4 range in October; 'a $4 stock' that 'could be a $24 stock'.
calls.base_case: Stage-two uptrend forming off a rounded bottom; one working drug transforms the story.
calls.bull_case: Analysts see 100%+ upside; pipeline drugs follow REC-1245 to market.
calls.bear_case: Not profitable yet; riskier turnaround story, peaked at $40 in 2021, $2bn market cap with $750m cash through 2029.
